title: 2014 HMMT November Guts Problem 8
statement: Find the number of digits in the decimal representation of \(2^{41}\).

solutions.text: \(\quad 13\) Noticing that \(2^{10}=1024 \approx 1000\) allows for a good estimate. Alternatively, the number of decimal digits of \(n\) is given by \(\left\lfloor\log _{10}(n)\right\rfloor+1\). Using \(\log _{10}(2) \approx 0.31\) also gives the correct answer. The exact value of \(2^{41}\) is 2199023255552 .
